updates.notes: 20d14a4e12 streams local staged attachments via File.openRead into SSH stdin and changes caps to 1 GiB (4 attachments) while preview cap stays 10 MiB. Native picker/cache/save is Android-only and not an OH backend. Expected length validated before/during stream (does not detect same-size mutation). Verification timeout is separate 30-minute budget, read operation 30 seconds; source removes upload whole-transfer 60-second timeout without adding a new upload inactivity deadline, so consumer recommends retaining cancellation/stall bounds rather than copying unbounded lifetime. Remote shell cleanup traps and staging cleanup inspected; source transfer success still not verified on any device. Later 68e1083a53 fixes Stream<Uint8List> and typed total accumulator.

updates.notes: Eager upload creates one remote token/path per attachment, reuses it across retries, stats remote length and resumes File.openRead(offset,expectedSize) with explicit acknowledged SFTP writes and final size equality. Host config is checked before/after opening dedicated connection. Task/generation/discarded state owns local staging and cancellation. Follow-up fixes SFTP variable null safety. Remote prefix/content identity is not verified: length alone and initial local stat do not detect same-size mutation; consumer requires immutable staging and identity validation or restart. No remote partial expiry policy demonstrated; recommends cleanup as a requirement. Write phase has cancellation and connection-close races but no explicit inactivity deadline. Retry owner state is in memory, not process-death recovery. Native attachment picker/export remains Android-only; no OH channel implementation or upload/device run established.
